firewall2Port.name: Firewall (2 ports)
firewall2Port.description: Stateful firewall appliance with an outside and an inside port and a console port. Traffic from a higher security level to a lower one is allowed and its replies return; the other way needs an access list.
firewall2Port.useCase: To protect an office or shop network from the internet with one firewall between the router and the LAN.

firewall3Port.name: Firewall (3 ports, DMZ)
firewall3Port.description: Stateful firewall appliance with outside, inside and DMZ ports and a console port.
firewall3Port.useCase: When a public server (web, mail) must be reachable from the internet without exposing the inside network.

router2Port.name: Router (2 ports)
router2Port.description: Branch router with two Gigabit Ethernet ports (LAN and WAN) and a console port.
router2Port.useCase: To connect one LAN to the internet or to another site.

router4Port.name: Router (4 ports)
router4Port.description: Router with four Gigabit Ethernet ports for several LANs or links.
router4Port.useCase: For a small core: several LANs, links to other routers, or router-on-a-stick with ports to spare.

router2PortSerial.name: Router (2 ports + serial)
router2PortSerial.description: Router with two Gigabit Ethernet ports and a two-port serial WAN card.
router2PortSerial.useCase: Classic WAN labs: join two sites over a serial line and practise static routes.

switch8.name: Switch (8 ports)
switch8.description: Small managed switch with eight Fast Ethernet ports.
switch8.useCase: Small office or a lab with a handful of devices; VLAN basics.

switch8Poe.name: PoE switch (8 ports)
switch8Poe.description: Eight Fast Ethernet ports that also power phones, cameras and access points (PoE).
switch8Poe.useCase: To power a few IP phones, cameras or an access point without adapters.

switch24.name: Switch (24 ports)
switch24.description: 24 Fast Ethernet ports and two Gigabit uplink ports.
switch24.useCase: Classic access switch for an office floor; trunk to the core over the uplinks.

switch24Poe.name: PoE switch (24 ports)
switch24Poe.description: 24 Fast Ethernet PoE ports and two Gigabit uplink ports.
switch24Poe.useCase: An office floor with IP phones and access points that need power.

switch48.name: Switch (48 ports)
switch48.description: 48 Fast Ethernet ports and four Gigabit fiber uplink ports.
switch48.useCase: A large floor or wiring closet; fiber uplinks for long runs to the core.

switch48Poe.name: PoE switch (48 ports)
switch48Poe.description: 48 Fast Ethernet PoE ports and four Gigabit fiber uplink ports.
switch48Poe.useCase: A large floor with many phones, cameras or access points.

l3Switch24.name: Layer 3 switch (24 ports)
l3Switch24.description: 24 Gigabit ports and four fiber uplinks; can route between VLANs.
l3Switch24.useCase: Core / distribution: route between VLANs inside the building without a router.

hub8.name: Hub (8 ports)
hub8.description: Old-style hub: repeats every frame to every port.
hub8.useCase: To see why switches replaced hubs: every device gets every frame.

accessPoint.name: Access point
accessPoint.description: Brings Wi-Fi clients into the wired network; one uplink port.
accessPoint.useCase: To add Wi-Fi to an existing wired network; cable it to a switch port.

wirelessRouter.name: Wireless router
wirelessRouter.description: Home / small-office router: internet port, four LAN ports, Wi-Fi, DHCP.
wirelessRouter.useCase: Home or very small office: one box for internet, Wi-Fi and automatic addresses.

pc.name: PC
pc.description: Desktop computer with a wired network card and a command prompt.
pc.useCase: A user’s desk computer; test the network with ping and ipconfig.

laptop.name: Laptop
laptop.description: Laptop with a wired and a Wi-Fi network card.
laptop.useCase: A user who switches between cable and Wi-Fi.

printer.name: Network printer
printer.description: Printer on the network with a wired port.
printer.useCase: Shared office printer; give it a fixed address so the PCs can find it.

ipPhone.name: IP phone
ipPhone.description: Desk phone that talks over the network.
ipPhone.useCase: Voice VLAN and PoE practice; cable it to a PoE switch port.

pos.name: POS terminal
pos.description: Cash register / payment terminal with a wired port.
pos.useCase: Shop or restaurant checkout; it must reach the payment service and the kitchen display.

ipCamera.name: IP camera
ipCamera.description: Security camera that streams over the network.
ipCamera.useCase: Security camera on a PoE switch; it must reach the NVR.

kitchenDisplay.name: Kitchen display
kitchenDisplay.description: Screen in the kitchen that shows orders from the POS.
kitchenDisplay.useCase: Restaurant labs: shows the orders the POS terminal sends.

smartphone.name: Smartphone
smartphone.description: Phone that joins the network over Wi-Fi.
smartphone.useCase: A Wi-Fi user: test SSIDs, passwords and guest networks.

tablet.name: Tablet
tablet.description: Tablet that joins the network over Wi-Fi.
tablet.useCase: A Wi-Fi device such as a waiter’s tablet or a guest’s device.

server.name: Server
server.description: Server with two network cards; can run DHCP and DNS.
server.useCase: File, DHCP or DNS server for a small network.

nvr.name: Video recorder (NVR)
nvr.useCase: Records the cameras; put it in the camera VLAN or let it reach them.

internetCloud.name: Internet (ISP)
internetCloud.description: The internet service provider: each port is one internet line.
internetCloud.useCase: Whenever the lab needs the internet; cable a router’s WAN port to one of its ports.

router3Port.name: Router (3 ports)
router3Port.description: Router with three Gigabit Ethernet ports, e.g. LAN, WAN and a second LAN or a DMZ.
router3Port.useCase: When one site has two separate networks (e.g. staff and guests) plus an internet line.

router4PortSerial.name: Router (4 ports + serial)
router4PortSerial.description: Router with four Gigabit Ethernet ports and a two-port serial WAN module.
router4PortSerial.useCase: Head-office router: several LANs plus serial lines to the branches.

switch5.name: Desktop switch (5 ports)
switch5.description: Compact plug-and-play switch with five Gigabit ports and no console port.
switch5.useCase: To add a few more sockets on a desk or in a small room.

switch16.name: Switch (16 ports)
switch16.description: 16 Fast Ethernet ports and two Gigabit uplink ports.
switch16.useCase: A floor or a shop with more devices than an 8-port switch can take.

switch16Poe.name: PoE switch (16 ports)
switch16Poe.description: 16 Fast Ethernet PoE ports and two Gigabit uplink ports.
switch16Poe.useCase: Medium camera or phone installations: power and data on one cable.

switch24Gig.name: Gigabit switch (24 ports)
switch24Gig.description: 24 Gigabit ports and four Gigabit fiber uplink ports.
switch24Gig.useCase: When users move large files or servers sit on the access layer.

switch24GigPoe.name: Gigabit PoE switch (24 ports)
switch24GigPoe.description: 24 Gigabit PoE ports and four Gigabit fiber uplink ports.
switch24GigPoe.useCase: Modern access layer: fast desks plus access points and cameras powered by the switch.

dslModem.name: DSL modem (Wi-Fi)
dslModem.description: Modem-router from the internet provider: DSL line port, four LAN ports, Wi-Fi, DHCP. In the lab the phone line is a copper cable to the Internet cloud.
dslModem.useCase: Typical home or shop internet over a phone line; cable its DSL port to the Internet cloud.

cableModem.name: Cable modem (Wi-Fi)
cableModem.description: Modem-router for cable TV internet: cable line port, two LAN ports, Wi-Fi, DHCP. In the lab the coax line is a copper cable to the Internet cloud.
cableModem.useCase: Home internet from a cable TV provider; it works like the wireless router.

multifunctionPrinter.name: Multifunction printer
multifunctionPrinter.description: Printer, scanner and copier with a wired port and Wi-Fi.
multifunctionPrinter.useCase: Office printer on cable or Wi-Fi; give it a fixed address.

smartTv.name: Smart TV / display
smartTv.description: Television or info screen with a wired port and Wi-Fi; plays content from the network.
smartTv.useCase: Meeting room, lobby or home: a screen that needs the internet or a media server.

rackServer.name: Rack server (4 NICs)
rackServer.description: Server-room server with four network cards; can run DHCP and DNS.
rackServer.useCase: Server-room labs: separate networks for users, backup and management.

wan.name: WAN
wan.description: Toward the internet provider or another site.

ethernet.name: Ethernet
ethernet.description: Gigabit Ethernet interface; use it for LAN or WAN.

serial.name: Serial
serial.description: Serial WAN line to another router; one end provides the clock (DCE).

access.name: Ports
access.description: Ports for end devices; access VLAN 1 by default.

uplink.name: Uplink
uplink.description: Faster port toward another switch or router.

shared.name: Ports
shared.description: Every port shares the same traffic.

handoff.name: Internet lines
handoff.description: Plug a router's WAN port in here.

console.name: Console
console.description: Management port for a console cable from a PC.

other.name: Other ports
other.description: Ports this model does not normally have.
